function: Hybrid beamforming: a CGAN fine-tunes the analog RF beamformer (phase shifters) from a coarse DFT beam and a WCGAN generates the baseband precoder, pp. 1-3.
system: Single-cell downlink mmWave massive MIMO-OFDM, BS ULA with 128 or 256 antennas and 8 RF chains, UE with 32 antennas, partially connected, 28 GHz, 32 subcarriers, no RIS, p. 4.
method: Conditional GAN (analog RF beamformer) and Wasserstein CGAN with gradient penalty (digital precoder), supervised adversarial training with L1 term on exhaustive-search and fully-digital targets, pp. 3-4.
data_channel: Own simulated geometric frequency-selective channel (5 clusters, 10 paths, Laplace angles, perfect CSI at BS); 4000 training and 1000 test channel matrices, pp. 2 and 4.
test_conditions: Train on 200 UE locations, test on 100 other locations of the same simulated distribution; SNR swept from -18 to 6 dB; Nt = 128 and 256, p. 4.
baselines: Non-learned: element-wise iterative MMSE and WMMSE hybrid beamforming [19], HBF of [18], fully-digital SVD precoder. Learned: DNN of [11] attempted but could not be adapted, p. 4.
metrics: Average spectral efficiency versus SNR, percentage gain over WMMSE and share of fully-digital SE, generator-loss convergence over epochs, pp. 4-5.
complexity: Post-training FLOPs: CGAN O(Nr Nt K); computing Heq,k takes 8 Nr Nt NRF K FLOPs; WCGAN O(Nr NRF K); CGAN runs faster than the references, p. 5.
q1_support: p. 4: "The MIMO channel is assumed to have Nc = 5 clusters with L = 10 paths per cluster". Custom geometric model with Laplace angles; only the path-loss formula comes from [18]. No 3GPP TR 38.901, DeepMIMO or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "The testing dataset consists of a further 1000 channel matrix samples" from the same simulated distribution (new UE locations); only the SNR is swept. No other scenario, band or configuration is used to test a trained model, and no adaptation is reported.
q3_support: p. 4: "We also attempted to adapt the DNN scheme from [11] to our multicarrier system, but were unsuccessful". Only non-learned baselines (MMSE, WMMSE [19], HBF [18], fully-digital) are compared, so there is no learned baseline.
q4_support: p. 5: "the CGAN has a computational complexity of O(Nr Nt K) in terms of the number of floating point oper" (ations, FLOPs); the same passage gives "the WCGAN has complexity" O(Nr NRF K).
q5_support: p. 4: "The training datasets for the CGAN and WCGAN consist of 4000 samples of channel matrix H", generated by the authors' own simulation. No code or data link and no public dataset are given anywhere in the paper.
notes: Correspondence on hybrid beamforming (area 3). The UE side is not learned: it uses the non-learned combiner of [19] (p. 4). Perfect CSI at the BS is assumed (p. 2). Results are averaged over 50 independent training-and-testing runs on the same datasets (p. 4). The paper itself says a complete complexity analysis does not fit (p. 5).
